_about: Shared by core/tests/unit/test_kind_verb_parity.py and frontend/src/constants/things.test.js. `kinds` is the map from a collection's kind to the verbs it holds (server: core.models.collection.KIND_THING_TYPES; browser: constants/things.js) and `cases` the verb a thing takes for a kind and a price (server: derive_thing_type, which decides it; browser: deriveThingType, which decides what the form shows and which verb the deployment's policy is asked about). `fee` is what the form holds and the server receives: a string or null. An unknown kind is left out on purpose: the server refuses it (KeyError) while the browser falls back to a stall, so the two do not treat it alike.

cases.note: a zero price is no price
a zero price written with decimals is no price
the smallest price is a price
a zero price is no price
a zero price written with decimals is no price
the smallest price is a price
a shed books without a price
a shed books at a zero price
a price does not change a shed's verb: it always books
